scenario: LDIA.2.1 — a `use` block line restating a setting the dialect already has is permitted and changes nothing. `default` has `regex: true`; restating it compiles, and the regex match in the rule is accepted. Drives override resolution.
rules_ds:
use default:
    regex: true

schema Msg scope logical:
    id: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /alarm/
->
    log info "x"
